claim: Specific performance of the sale and purchase agreement under Order 86
requested_remedy: Specific performance of the sale and purchase agreement under Order 86

facts.F1: On 25 November 1996, the plaintiff and defendant entered into a provisional agreement for sale and purchase of a flat in Shatin.
facts.F2: The agreed price was $12,550,000, consisting of a $500,000 initial deposit, a $755,000 further deposit upon signing of the Formal Agreement on or before 10-12-1996, and a balance of $11,295,000 upon completion on or before 7-01-1997.
facts.F3: The agreement required the seller to deliver vacant possession of the premises to the Purchaser upon completion.
facts.F4: Clauses 6 and 7 of the agreement stipulated that the seller could back out of the sale by returning the initial deposit plus an equal sum and paying stamp duty if he failed to complete the sale in accordance with the agreement.
facts.F5: On 6, 9 and 10 December 1996, the Purchaser's solicitors requested a draft sale and purchase agreement from the Seller's solicitors.
facts.F6: The Purchaser's solicitors delivered a formal agreement signed by the Purchaser, along with the further deposit cheque, on 10 December 1996.
facts.F7: The Seller's solicitors returned the formal agreement and cheque, and sent their own cheque for $1 million, purporting to act under clause 7, on 12 December 1996.
facts.F8: The Seller's solicitors claimed the Seller had the right to back out of the sale under clause 7, even though the deadline for signing the formal agreement had passed.
facts.F9: The seller's obligation to complete the sale included executing the assignment and doing what else was required of him under the agreement leading to that final act.
facts.F10: The signing of a formal agreement on or before 10 December 1996 was part of the seller's obligation to complete the sale.
facts.F11: The seller's failure to sign the formal agreement on or before 10 December 1996 meant he had failed to complete the sale in accordance with the agreement.
facts.F12: The seller delayed exercising his rights under clause 7 for 2 days after the deadline for signing the formal agreement had passed.
